summary: Presenting 5 inquiry questions with a mix of Yes/No and multiple choice formats.

inquiry.message: Please answer the following questions to help me assist you better:

new_feature.title: Are you looking to add a new feature?
new_feature.description: Whether this request involves building something new

area.title: Which area of the application does this concern?
area.description: Select the part of the codebase you want to work on

has_tests.title: Should this include tests?
has_tests.description: Whether you want test coverage for the changes

additional_context.title: Any additional context?
additional_context.description: Optional: provide extra details about what you need
